product_outcome: The browser popup refreshes real capture state through the existing service-worker query whenever it becomes visible again.
Users no longer need to press Start or Stop just to discover whether tab capture has changed while the popup was hidden.
Visibility refresh preserves the established error-persistence boundary and does not overwrite an error with Idle.

verification.extension_gate: PASS; popup visibility source boundary enforced.

evidence_boundary: Static extension source gate and offline self-tests only.
No runtime browser automation, physical audio, driver install/load/HLK or Microsoft signing claim.
